scenes.setting: Outside Unit 48: the stunned Sanguine haggles — see the patient first, and a greater bounty plus 'the friendship of the Sanguine' if the Mental Terror Candle's seed can be removed — then rushes to his figurines while Klein muses whether Vampire Ancestor Lilith is the primitive moon
scenes.text_anchor: “… and the friendship of the Sanguine.”

scenes.setting: Evening at 15 Minsk Street: six soli and a dry, precise thank-you letter from Jurgen Cooper for the cat-sitting; then the reply to Detective Stuart is drafted — Emlyn found, a Harvest Church 'volunteer' — to be hand-delivered tomorrow for the sake of early payment

Wednesday: nostalgic Desi seafood fried rice, then performance lessons — enemies and participants shape the act; the Tudor-ruins evil spirit and Will Auceptin's tarot card weighed and shelved — and an afternoon studying the Book of Secrets by the fireplace
scenes.text_anchor: This is truly a moving and nostalgic taste…

scenes.setting: Noon doorbell: Detective Stuart, thin and bearded, arrives in reverent excitement — 'You really are a great detective!' — and Klein feels his potion digest a little: an audience of one, applauding
scenes.text_anchor: “You really are a great detective with abundant resources and channels.
